name: ginnungagap
description: Kosmos Compose project: what runs directly in Docker Desktop on the host

comments.noDependencies: There are no runtime dependencies and there never should be. What is built here is dist/compose.yaml, and the build is docker compose config rather than anything from npm. Node is present only as this repository's tooling language, which is the same role it plays in kosmos.yggdrasil, a repository that also ships no JavaScript.
comments.testRunner: The tests use node:test rather than a framework, so the suites run with nothing installed. Only the hooks, commitlint and prettier need node_modules.
comments.deploy: predeploy runs automatically before deploy, so a compose file that fails its own invariant tests cannot reach Kosmos. That gate is the reason this is an npm script rather than a shell script.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:shell && npm run lint:format
scripts.predeploy: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
